d:
In this episode of Guest in the Newsroom, versatile actor Ashish Vidyarthi graces our newsroom. Beyond acting, he's a renowned motivational speaker, podcaster, and stand-up comedian. Hear his inspiring journey from the beginning until now, as he discusses his diverse filmography, favorite films, and upcoming projects. From his NSD days to his unique food preferences, this episode is a must-watch for all his fans."
